What changed in Shader Wall, newest first.
Wallpaper performance, and a private address for agents
Wallpaper performance in Settings: Maximum, Balanced, Efficient, or a preset of your own.
The wallpaper pauses while a window covers the desktop, the display sleeps, or the screen locks.
Agents connect with an address that holds this Mac's private key, so a web page can't reach the app.
The homepage became a Mac desktop
Shader Wall runs on this page: open it from the Dock, pick a shader, and set it as the wallpaper.
Terminal and Claude in the Dock show an agent changing the wallpaper.
The Dock uses Tahoe's icons and magnifies under the pointer.
The type on the desktop turns dark over a bright wallpaper.
The earlier scrolling page moved to /tour.
A native window with a glass sidebar, a Saved library, and chat that writes new shaders.
Every Paper shader that runs without an image, each with its own controls.
Make Editable Copy, and a keyboard shortcut for every command.
Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP agent can browse, edit, and create shaders.
Animated shaders behind your windows, on every display.
Import a shader, or describe one in chat with your own API key.
Shader Wall is in beta, and coming to macOS 26 Tahoe.
What it does, and where to find it.
Every shader Paper makes, from Mesh Gradient to God Rays, each with its own controls. Pick one in the sidebar.
Puts the look behind your windows on every display. While it's on the desktop, every edit follows it live.
Sliders for speed, shape, grain, and glow, and a palette you can add to. Random rolls a fresh look.
Save as New keeps a variation in Saved. Rename, duplicate, or update it whenever you like.
Presets stay as Paper made them. A copy looks the same, lives in My Shaders, and can take new controls.
Say what you want to see and chat writes the shader, with sliders to shape it. Uses your own OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini key.
GLSL, ISF, Shadertoy, or Shader Wall JSON. Drop a file on the window, or use Import in the sidebar.
Let the shader cover your desktop icons for a clean screen. It's in Settings.
Connect Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP agent. Turn on agent access in Settings, then try Terminal or Claude in the Dock.
Every command is in the menu bar with a shortcut. Search them all from Help.
Shader Wall is coming to macOS 26 Tahoe. Everything here works on this page, so go ahead.
